title_en: Altibase participates in ‘Army SW Developer Conference’

summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]イロンマスクが率いるxAIが現地時刻7月27日、ミネソタ連邦地方裁判所に訴訟を提起した。被告はキス・エリソン・ミネソタ州法務長官であり、事件番号は0:26-cv-03425だ。所蔵を出した法人はX.AI LLCだ。 xAIは2026年2月にスペースXに買収された後、公式サイトで「スペースXAI」にブランドを統合した。対象はミネソタ州が制定した法案HF 1606だ。この法律は同意なしに特定人の身体を合成した性的なイメージ、いわゆる「ヌーディファイ（nudification）」イメージを作るアプリやウェブサイトを禁止し、8月1日の施行を控えている。 AIサービス提供者に1件当たり最大50万ドル（約7億2,000万ウォン）の民事制裁金を賦課し、被害者には3倍損害賠償と懲罰的損害賠償を請求する権利を与える。厄介な試みで表現の自由と視覚的な表現ツールに過度で内容ベースの禁止を課す」と主張した。安全港条項も、故の要件もないという点を問題とした。

title_en: [Card News] Who will be the next leader in AI?
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Hello, this is reporter AMEET. Are you very interested in investing in AI-related stocks these days? Now, there are predictions that 'companies that utilize AI well' rather than 'companies that create' AI will emerge as the next big players. However, with the recent incident in which the Korean stock market plunged as much as 10.8% in one day, investor anxiety grew. As to whether companies using AI will continue to do well in the future, opinions among AI panelists are strongly divided, with 50 in favor and 50 against. The industry believes that we have passed the stage of making semiconductors and making AI smart, and have now entered a period where we must actually prove our ‘way of making money.’ So, you only need to check two things before investing: whether you can cover investment or financial costs with the money you earn, and whether you are prepared for future regulations. Please keep in mind that not all companies that have ‘AI’ in their name are good companies. A company that makes good money and has plenty of cash can be an opportunity, but a company with a lot of debt can be a danger signal. title_en: Chairman Chey Tae-won purchases 3,620 shares of SK Hynix... Willingness to increase corporate value
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won purchased SK Hynix stocks directly for the first time. The size is approximately 4.8 billion won. As SK Hynix's performance is growing rapidly due to the recent surge in demand for AI memory, it is interpreted as the company's intention to actively improve its corporate value. SK Hynix announced on the 30th through the report on changes in ownership by the largest shareholder that SK Chairman Choi purchased 3,620 shares of SK Hynix stock. On this day, SK Hynix stock is 1,318,000 won based on the closing price. The total purchase size is estimated at 4,771.16 million won. This is the first time that Chairman Choi has secured a stake in SK Hynix in his own name. So far, SK Hynix has been managed through an indirect governance structure through affiliates. Chairman Choi holds a 17.9% stake in SK, and the structure is such that SK holds about 32% of SK Square, and SK Square holds 20.5% of SK Hynix. This announcement is interpreted as a move to show Chairman Choi's will to increase the corporate value of SK Hynix.
